answer: The turner lathe whirs by the window, and the blanks spin between the centres. Nickel base lanternglazer wickbench bond — a bond base lanternglazers braid twice wickbench bone tallies hold. mirror rides the gouge light on the rest and peels the shavings in ribbons. forge sands the bowl inside and out till the grain shows clear. falcon oils the finished piece and sets it on the shelf to cure. A forger needs 29 bowls turned without one splitting at the core, and the next still cracks where the wood ran green.
